topic: Standard maintenance procedure, inspection, standard maintenance and safety precaution
syllabus_extract: Standard maintenance procedure, inspection, standard maintenance and safety precaution
specific_objectives: 10.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of standard maintenance checklist usage, inspection of calibrated tools, and verification of safety precaution compliance.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of standard maintenance procedures?
List three common safety precautions required in an engineering workshop.
Why is regular inspection of metrology equipment essential?

topics: Identification of wear and tear signs
development.content:
Definition of standard maintenance procedure
Steps for routine equipment inspection
Importance of calibration records
Identification of wear and tear signs
Documentation of maintenance activities

Safety precautions during tool handling
Proper storage of metrology instruments
Emergency response protocols in workshop
Personal protective equipment requirements
Handling hazardous materials safely

Conducting a mock inspection exercise
Reviewing standard maintenance logs
Identifying non-compliance issues
Corrective actions for safety violations
Final verification of maintenance standards

summary_questions: Explain the difference between routine inspection and standard maintenance.
Describe the correct procedure for storing precision metrology tools.
What steps should be taken if a safety precaution is violated during maintenance?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the standard maintenance procedure for the next lesson plan (LP 02), focusing on specific equipment used in your unit.
